$comment: Declares the MDM/dbt/bookkeeping Snowflake-credential secret family (6 secrets) this platform depends on, so no script has to independently hardcode a secret name string (credential-isolation architecture review, Candidate 2). Full secret id is always "${name_prefix}/<name>", where name_prefix is edgartools-<env-name>. Populating scripts read their target name via infra/scripts/lib/secrets-manifest.sh's secrets_manifest_name(), which fails loudly on a name this file doesn't declare. NOT yet covered here: edgar-identity and runner-credentials, two other secrets Terraform creates (infra/terraform/modules/warehouse_runtime/main.tf) under a separate hyphenated (non "/"-namespaced) legacy naming convention -- out of this ticket's scope, not an oversight.

secrets.name: mdm/postgres_dsn
secrets.description: PostgreSQL connection string for MDM's operational store (Snowflake-hosted Postgres application role).

secrets.name: bookkeeping/postgres_dsn
secrets.description: PostgreSQL connection string for the bookkeeping store's operational tables (Snowflake-hosted Postgres, same instance as MDM but a dedicated bookkeeping_app LOGIN role -- not MDM's application credential). The populating script is written and tested but has not yet run against live prod (DuckDB Retirement Cutover Ticket 04's live-execution half is still blocked on Ticket 03) -- flip populated_in_prod to true only once that run actually happens.

secrets.name: mdm/snowflake
secrets.description: Snowflake connection settings (account/user/password/warehouse/database/role) for MDM export and graph sync ECS tasks. Derived from dbt/snowflake below, not typed independently.

secrets.name: mdm/neo4j
secrets.description: Neo4j connection details. Unused since the neo4j-snowflake migration moved graph data inside Snowflake itself (Neo4j Graph Analytics Native App) -- there is no external Neo4j database to connect to. Terraform-created container, deliberately never populated.

secrets.name: mdm/api_keys
secrets.description: MDM API key container. Deferred -- the go-live launch-gate matrix marks this consumer unclear; never populated.

secrets.name: dbt/snowflake
secrets.description: Snowflake connection settings (account/user/password/warehouse/database/role) for dbt gold-layer runs; bootstrap-prod-mdm.sh reads this to derive mdm/snowflake. Still no Terraform resource -- this secret's container was never Terraform-managed, only ever populated by hand before Ticket 4 of the credential-isolation breakdown added bootstrap-dbt-snowflake-secret.sh as its populating script. Ticket 03 ("Write a committed bootstrap script for the dbt/snowflake AWS secret") on the snowflake-account-recutover wayfinder map (.scratch/snowflake-account-recutover/issues/03-write-dbt-snowflake-secret-bootstrap-script.md, on a different, currently-paused branch) covers the same gap -- when that branch resumes, close it as a duplicate of this rather than shipping a second script.
